assessments.reasoning: Section 27 requires the expanded 3.0 operating mode. Section 27.7 governs optional XPath 3.1 support, with its own consequences and qualifications.

challenge.method: Compare a basic 3.0 processor that implements the map and JSON-processing extensions with a processor offering the 3.1 feature. Check independently named XPath authority and the separate higher-order feature condition.
challenge.results: Basic conformance includes the named 3.0 specifications with the two extensions. An optional 3.1 mode remains subject to §27.7. The base extensions do not make every 3.1 facility mandatory and the separate higher-order qualification is retained.

limitations: The source is the exact acquired W3C edition identified by the evidence record. The observed 2021 metadata notice and independently inspected linked context do not supply a different normative edition.
This is a processor conformance mode obligation of dated XSLT 3.0. It supplies no equivalence of language identities, universal 3.1 support, or implementation observation.
